title: AI and outbound data destinations
acceptance_scenarios: Exercise every enabled AI/speech/analytics/support caller, redirects and queued work. Verify missing/withdrawn purpose blocks consent-dependent transmission and network logs show no disallowed payload left.
evidence_after_implementation: A12-data-flow-and-destinations.pdf; caller-coverage.csv; egress-denial-results.json; redacted outbound observations; provider location and processing terms.
manual_acceptance: DPO/security approves destinations and actual provider practices. A local label/private address or unchecked cloud flag is insufficient. Refresh on provider/model/endpoint, subprocessors or new callers.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Central BI provider guard defaults unknown callers to records, binds patient AI consent to a reviewed destination, refuses remote patient text and disables redirects. Speech uses purpose/recipient gates. Free questions containing undetectable names require an approved local analytics destination.
remaining_actions: Approve actual countries, processor terms, legal bases and destinations. Verify network controls/DNS routing and any providers outside these call paths; no complete all-integration egress claim is made.
